bajkaj-landfill-land-taken-before-paymen.conditions_add: The credit agreement of 29 June 2005 required Albania to take, or cause to be taken, all measures necessary for the implementation of the Environmental and Social Safeguards Framework and the Resettlement Plan (Schedule 4, paragraph 2), and required the project coordination unit to be operational and adequately staffed by 3 October 2005 under terms of reference acceptable to the Association. The framework, as the agreement defines it in Article I, set out measures addressing land acquisition and resettlement arising from the Saranda solid waste investments, and amending, suspending or waiving it was listed in Section 5.01(g) as an event entitling the Association to stop the money. The Bank's completion report of 27 April 2016 says that all required safeguard documents, including the framework, environmental management plans and resettlement action plans, were prepared, consulted on and disclosed, and that resettlement action plan implementation was covenanted in the legal agreement for the project as restructured in March 2010; on the landfill itself it says compensation for 3.2 hectares taken from 21 people was resolved before closing, full payments made in 13 cases and the money for the 8 owners who had died or were living abroad set aside in a special escrow account.

why.safeguard: required Albania to take, or cause to be taken, all measures necessary for the implementation of the Environmental and Social Safeguards Framework and the Resettlement Plan
why.admin: required the project coordination unit to be operational and adequately staffed by 3 October 2005

bajkaj-landfill-land-taken-before-paymen.searched: Read the conformed credit agreement C4083-AL and the completion report on disk; Schedule 4, paragraph 2 and Section 5.01(g) of the agreement carry the safeguards covenant and the suspension event, and the completion report's safeguards annex carries the Bajkaj compensation figures.

shkodra-lezha-school-sites-land-cleared.conditions_add: The original financing agreement of 6 July 2006 required Albania to carry out its obligations in accordance with an environmental management plan adopted on 15 March 2006 and not to amend, suspend or waive it without the Association's approval (Schedule 2, Section II.1); it set no resettlement requirement, and the completion report of 28 March 2014 says the Bank had approved new school construction that "was not supported by the Financing Agreement". After the Municipality of Shkodra ordered a 5,000 square metre orchard demolished in June 2008, the restructuring approved in March 2010 revised the financing agreement, the report says, "specifically establishing that the Recipient was required: (a) to comply with the agreed RPF, including retroactive application of the RPF to expropriation actions that had already been undertaken in connection with school construction at Shkodra and other sites, and (b) to prepare site-specific ARAPs prior to construction". The amended agreement also carried a dated covenant obliging the government to compensate the affected party at Shkodra by 30 April 2010, which the report says was met by May 2010.

why.safeguard: required: (a) to comply with the agreed RPF, including retroactive application of the RPF to expropriation actions that had already been undertaken

rn34-colonia-santa-rosa-canteen-eviction.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 27 June 2008 required Argentina, through the national roads agency, to "ensure that any works under the Project do not involve any Resettlement" (Schedule 2, Section I.G); the agreement defines resettlement as any involuntary taking of land under the project that harms a person's living standard, property, access to productive assets, or business, work or place of residence. Section I.D required an environmental screening or assessment of each set of works before they began and, where the Bank so determined, an environmental management plan acceptable to the Bank, to be implemented immediately after approval. Before entering into a road maintenance contract, other than the ones carried over from an earlier loan, the agency also had to give the Bank a report satisfactory to the Bank showing the works' road network priority and their economic feasibility, "including a showing that the economic rate of return for such works, calculated in accordance with criteria satisfactory to the Bank, is expected to be at least twelve percent" (Section I.I).

why.safeguard: ensure that any works under the Project do not involve any Resettlement
why.fincov: including a showing that the economic rate of return for such works, calculated in accordance with criteria satisfactory to the Bank, is expected to be at least twelve percent

rn34-colonia-santa-rosa-canteen-eviction.searched: Read the conformed loan agreement L7473-AR on disk; Schedule 2, Section I carries the no-resettlement covenant, the environmental screening requirement and the rate-of-return report.

balakhani-landfill-families-and-waste-pi.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 20 May 2009 required Azerbaijan to ensure that each resettlement action plan was "prepared in a manner satisfactory to the Bank in accordance with the RPF prior to commencement of any activities for the areas where physical relocation, land acquisition and/or loss of income due to the Project activities have been identified", and carried out in a timely manner satisfactory to the Bank (Schedule 2, Section I.C.2). It also required all measures necessary for carrying out the environmental management framework, the environmental management plan and the resettlement policy framework to be taken in time. The additional financing agreement of 10 January 2014 repeated both requirements and added that Azerbaijan could not assign, amend, abrogate or waive any of those instruments except as the Bank agreed.

why.safeguard: prepared in a manner satisfactory to the Bank in accordance with the RPF prior to commencement of any activities

balakhani-landfill-families-and-waste-pi.searched: Read both conformed agreements on disk, L7549-AZ and the 2014 additional financing L8274-AZ; the covenant is at Schedule 2, Section I.C in each.

burundi-fibre-backbone-unpaid-compensati.conditions_add: The financing agreement for Grant H283-BI, dated 22 May 2007, required Burundi to implement the project in accordance with an Environmental and Social Management Framework of 2 February 2007 and a Resettlement Policy Framework of 5 February 2007, and barred amending, abrogating or waiving either without the Association's agreement where that could materially harm the project (Schedule 2, Section I.D.1). The agreement defines the resettlement framework as setting out the principles and procedures to be followed where any activity leads to land acquisition or the loss of livelihoods, and required sub-projects likely to have an adverse social impact to be appraised, approved and monitored under the two frameworks. It also required Burundi to keep a socio-environmental specialist responsible for carrying them out in post throughout the project.

why.safeguard: required Burundi to implement the project in accordance with an Environmental and Social Management Framework
why.admin: required Burundi to keep a socio-environmental specialist responsible for carrying them out in post throughout the project

burundi-fibre-backbone-unpaid-compensati.searched: Read the conformed financing agreement for Grant H283-BI on disk; Schedule 2, Section I.D carries the safeguards covenant and the Appendix defines the resettlement framework.

takon-landfill-land-taken-porto-novo.conditions_add: The credit agreement of 3 November 2005 required Benin, before approving any project activity that might have negative environmental and social impacts, to develop the instruments the Environmental and Social Management Framework called for, which "wherever applicable" included "a Resettlement Action Plan (RAP), acceptable to the Association, giving details of a program of actions, measures and policies designed to facilitate the compensation and resettlement of Affected Persons, including the magnitude of displacement, proposed compensation and resettlement arrangements, budget and cost estimates, and sources of funding" (Schedule 4, Part D, paragraph 12). The same part required the project to be carried out in accordance with those assessments and plans and barred amending or waiving them without the Association's agreement, and required the project unit and the Benin environment agency to review and clear each assessment and plan. The project description in the agreement makes the carrying out of resettlement action plans an activity the credit paid for, and the additional financing agreement of 12 September 2008 carried the same requirements.

why.safeguard: a Resettlement Action Plan (RAP), acceptable to the Association, giving details of a program of actions, measures and policies designed to facilitate the compensation and resettlement of Affected Persons
why.admin: required the project unit and the Benin environment agency to review and clear each assessment and plan

tema-ouagadougou-bamako-corridor-compens.conditions_add: The financing agreement for Credit 4438-BF, dated 8 July 2008, required Burkina Faso to carry out its part of the project in accordance with the Environment and Social Management Plan and the Resettlement Policy Framework, and barred it abrogating, amending, repealing, suspending or waiving either without the Association's written agreement (Schedule 2, Section I.D). The agreement's Appendix defines that framework to include, by name, the abbreviated compensation plan for the strengthening works on the Ouagadougou to Sakoinsé section of National Road 1, prepared in October 2007 - the stretch where the works began before compensation was finished. The Mali financing agreement for Credit 4435-ML, dated 17 July 2008, placed the same requirement on Mali for the Mali activities.

tema-ouagadougou-bamako-corridor-compens.searched: Read the conformed financing agreements for Credit 4438-BF and Credit 4435-ML on disk; the Burkina Faso Appendix names the RN1 Ouagadougou-Sakoinse compensation plan inside the defined Resettlement Policy Framework.

dangriga-market-vendors-income-loss.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 2 December 2010 required that where a land acquisition or involuntary resettlement plan was needed for a sub-project, "no works under a Subproject shall be commenced until (A) all measures required to be taken under said Land Acquisition and/or Resettlement Plan prior to the initiation of said works have been taken; (B) BSIF has prepared and furnished to the Bank a report in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank, on the status of compliance with the requirements of said Land Acquisition and/or Involuntary Resettlement Plan; and (C) the Bank has confirmed that said works may be commenced" (Schedule 2, Section I.F.1(b)). The same section required the plan to be prepared under the Land Acquisition and Involuntary Resettlement Policy Framework, disclosed locally and sent to the Bank as part of the annual work plan, and required Belize to keep the Bank informed of measures taken, of anything interfering with the plan and of remedies.

el-alto-avenue-land-paid-for-afterwards.conditions_add: The financing agreement of 14 March 2007 required the city of El Alto to submit each sub-project to the Association for approval before any of the credit could be withdrawn for it, and to send with it an environmental management plan satisfactory to the Association and, where applicable, "an abbreviated resettlement plan or other action plan for resettlement of the population affected by the El Alto Subproject prepared in accordance with the Resettlement Framework and to be implemented in accordance with the terms therein", together with inter-institutional arrangements satisfactory to the Association, and to carry out the sub-project only on the terms the Association had approved (Schedule 4, Section III). The completion report of 26 March 2018 says the land for Avenida Santa Vera Cruz Tramo 1 was given up under a "voluntary cession of land" that had been planned before the project's identification phase but carried out after the Bank's involvement in project identification, and that the implementing agency later prepared an abbreviated resettlement plan giving retroactive, in-kind compensation to six property owners; the report does not date the cession, so whether it happened before or after the agreement of 14 March 2007 cannot be settled from it. The additional financing agreement of 21 March 2013 required the El Alto municipal government to implement the resettlement policy framework and the relevant resettlement plan in a manner acceptable to the Association (Schedule 2, Section I.D.2), and undertook "that the proceeds of the Financing shall not be used to finance land acquisition in La Paz or El Alto", with a duty to refund the Association any amount of the credit found to have paid for such land (Schedule 2, Section V).

why.safeguard: an abbreviated resettlement plan or other action plan for resettlement of the population affected by the El Alto Subproject prepared in accordance with the Resettlement Framework
why.fincov: that the proceeds of the Financing shall not be used to finance land acquisition in La Paz or El Alto

el-alto-avenue-land-paid-for-afterwards.searched: Read both conformed agreements and the completion report on disk; the 2007 agreement's Schedule 4, Section III carries the pre-approval resettlement plan requirement, the 2013 agreement's Section V bars financing land acquisition, and the completion report's social section describes the cession and the retroactive plan without dating either.

ceara-sanear-ii-resettlement.conditions_add: The guarantee agreement of 19 March 2009 required the Federative Republic of Brazil to guarantee, "as primary obligor and not as surety merely, the due and punctual payment of all Loan Payments payable by the Borrower", the State of Ceara, under Loan 7600-BR (Section 2.01). The Bank's completion report of 18 December 2012 says the money itself was tied to performance: "loan disbursements were linked to performance targets", of which a "70% rule" "required the GoC to disburse at least 70 percent of the approved annual budget in each Eligible Expenditure Program (EEP) budget line", with disbursement-linked indicators carrying annual targets for each sector, while performance against a second set of indicators did not affect disbursements. On the 114 families moved, the same report says the appropriate framework, involving both consultation and compensation, was applied and that "As required, the GoC notified the World Bank before the actions were taken".

why.fincov: required the GoC to disburse at least 70 percent of the approved annual budget in each Eligible Expenditure Program (EEP) budget line

pinheiros-station-collapse-sao-paulo.conditions_add: The loan agreement for Loan 4646-BR, dated 25 June 2002, required the State of Sao Paulo to "carry out or cause to be carried out the Environmental Mitigation Plan and the Resettlement Plan in accordance with the terms thereof" (Section 3.01(b)), the resettlement plan being the borrower's own plan for the people to be displaced by the Line 4 works, set out in its environmental impact assessment of 27 July 2001 and updated in November 2001. The loan could not become effective until the resettlement plan was "being carried out in accordance with the terms thereof" and until the environmental impact assessment had been approved and the licence for the works issued by the state environmental agency (Section 6.01(b) and (d)). Effectiveness also depended on a guarantee agreement being signed with the Federative Republic of Brazil and on a project coordination unit and a project management unit being set up with structures, functions and staff satisfactory to the Bank (Sections 6.01(a) and (c), 3.03 and 3.04).

why.safeguard: carry out or cause to be carried out the Environmental Mitigation Plan and the Resettlement Plan in accordance with the terms thereof
why.admin: a project coordination unit and a project management unit being set up with structures, functions and staff satisfactory to the Bank
why.repay: Effectiveness also depended on a guarantee agreement being signed with the Federative Republic of Brazil

santos-vila-gilda-stilt-house-resettleme.conditions_add: The guarantee agreement of 8 February 2010 is the only agreement published for this loan. In it the Federative Republic of Brazil "unconditionally guarantees, as primary obligor and not as surety merely, the due and punctual payment of all Loan Payments payable by the Borrower", the Municipality of Santos, under Loan 7807-BR (Section 2.01). The loan agreement with the municipality, which would carry any resettlement covenant, is not published, and the Bank's completion report of 7 June 2016 records what the Bank asked for during supervision rather than a term of the financing: that the Bank "had no objection" to the municipality's proposed change of plan "but asked the Municipality to prepare a new separated RAP", that "the Bank Team required the Municipality to update the original RAP", and that when a May 2012 mission found 65 newly identified families had been moved into other stilt houses, "disregarding the RAP terms and the Bank Policies", the Bank notified the municipality that all of them had to be moved to the new housing complex under the approved plan.

why.repay: "unconditionally guarantees, as primary obligor and not as surety merely, the due and punctual payment of all Loan Payments payable by the Borrower"

thimphu-land-pooling-compensation-arrear.conditions_add: The financing agreement of 13 July 2010 required Bhutan to carry out the project in conformity with a Safeguards Diagnostic Review and the resettlement action plans, and not to change or amend the review without the Association's prior agreement (Schedule 2, Section I.D.1). It required the plans for Dechencholing and Langjuphaka to be carried out so as to minimise any involuntary loss of land, shelter, productive assets or livelihood and to maintain or improve the living standards of displaced people, to be kept on display where displaced people could reach them, and to have their implementation audited, with any corrective measures taken with the Association's prior agreement (Section I.D.4). It also required land pooling under Part 2 to follow Bhutan's Land Pooling Rules and the land pooling agreements with landowners and tenants, under guidelines acceptable to the Association, and the additional financing agreement of 19 May 2014 repeated the requirements for the Thimphu Thromde.

why.safeguard: required Bhutan to carry out the project in conformity with a Safeguards Diagnostic Review and the resettlement action plans

morupule-b-family-moved-fatal-accidents.conditions_add: The Bank's safeguards review mission aide-memoire of October 2011 sets out, with section references, the key legal undertakings of the loan agreement for Loan 7801-BW and of the project agreement, neither of which is published. Botswana Power Corporation and its contractors had to "ensure that there is no displacement or restriction of access shall occur before the RAP and full payment of the displaced persons of compensation and any assistance for relocations" (loan agreement Schedule 2, Section I.D.3; project agreement Schedule, Section I.C.3), recorded as "On going" at 30 September 2011, and under the guarantee project agreement were "not permit construction on a part of the site until any RAP is implemented and compensation paid" (Clause 8.1(q)) and to carry out the works "in conformity with the provisions of the EMPs, RPF, RAPs, and Pest Management Plan" (Clause 8.1(b)(i)), the latter recorded as ongoing with the note that "EPC Contractor management of work site safety continues to be problematic". The same table sets out conditions on electricity pricing and regulation: an agreed tariff adjustment plan to be prepared and implemented by 9 December 2010 (Schedule 2, Section V(a)), recorded as done; an agreed tariff policy by 30 September 2010 (Section V(b)), recorded as in progress; and an independent regulator responsible for implementing an agreed electricity policy by 30 June 2011 (Section V(c)), recorded as on going. The cooperation agreement of 15 December 2009 between the Bank and China Export and Credit Insurance Corporation records the security behind the plant's money: an export credit facility from the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China of up to US$825,048,559.40 to the corporation under an agreement of 15 June 2009; a deed of guarantee from Botswana, through its Ministry of Finance and Development Planning, covering principal and interest payable under that facility; a Sinosure insurance policy covering payment defaults by the corporation for fifteen years; and an IBRD guarantee to the facility agent of up to US$242,661,341 of principal plus one interest instalment, covering the fifteenth to the twentieth year.

why.safeguard: "ensure that there is no displacement or restriction of access shall occur before the RAP and full payment of the displaced persons of compensation and any assistance for relocations"
why.prices: an agreed tariff adjustment plan to be prepared and implemented by 9 December 2010
why.admin: an independent regulator responsible for implementing an agreed electricity policy by 30 June 2011
why.repay: a deed of guarantee from Botswana, through its Ministry of Finance and Development Planning, covering principal and interest payable under that facility

Where a sub-project or a change to the design or works would displace anyone, a further resettlement action plan had to be prepared under the Resettlement Policy Framework, given to the Bank for review and implemented only once the Bank had accepted it. Any modification or waiver of a plan or of the framework needed the Bank's prior concurrence.

shihutang-dam-ganjiang-relocation.conditions_add: The loan agreement for Loan 7580-CN, dated 28 November 2008, required China to make the loan proceeds available to Jiangxi "under terms and conditions satisfactory to the Bank", which the agreement then sets out: the principal in dollars, recovered over twenty-five years with an eight-year grace period, at the Bank's own rate of interest and front-end fee (Schedule 2, Section I.A). abidjan-lagos-corridor-road-works-deaths.conditions_add: The Bank stopped part of the money. Its completion report of 18 December 2019 says disbursements for the road component were suspended between December 2016 and June 2017 "because of serious occupational safety and road safety issues on the road works that resulted in 22 accidents, including five fatalities in 6 months, non-compliance of the reporting requirements since the accidents were reported to the World Bank, and non-compliance of the provisions of the RAP, since civil works had been proceeding while the RAP had not been fully executed four years into project implementation". The report says that over the following eight months a nine-point action plan was prepared with the government, moving project management to a new implementation unit, appointing a new deputy coordinator, ordering social, environmental, technical and safety audits, adding an environmental and a social specialist to the unit and setting a new reporting protocol, and that substantial efforts were made "to lift the suspension of disbursements". It ties those measures to the money directly: the project implementation unit was moved from the Ministry of Economy and Finance to the Ministry of Economic Infrastructure in December 2016 "to comply with the conditions to lift the suspension on disbursements".

why.safeguard: non-compliance of the provisions of the RAP, since civil works had been proceeding while the RAP had not been fully executed
why.admin: "to comply with the conditions to lift the suspension on disbursements"

kribi-gas-plant-land-and-crops-taken-mpo.conditions_add: The Bank's completion report of 23 October 2019 sets out what the guarantee secured rather than what it demanded of the plant: the IDA guarantee covered a pool of five local commercial banks that lent CFA 40 billion against debt service default caused by the government breaching named obligations under a Government Commitment Agreement, including buyout payments triggered by early termination of the gas supply agreement, unilateral modification or breach of the electricity sales and generation licences, political force majeure, and the non-renewal or termination of the ENEO concession without an acceptable replacement. It also backstopped the government's duty to buy out the lenders' participations after the first seven years under a loan purchase agreement, and the Republic of Cameroon signed an indemnity agreement with the Association in May 2012. A Bank briefing paper of 2015 sets out the contractual structure and shows the project agreement between the Association and the power company carrying representations and warranties, covenants and a good-faith obligation to extend or refinance the local loan by year seven, without stating what those covenants were. On environmental and social matters the completion report says the lenders engaged an independent adviser, Sargent & Lundy Consulting, to verify compliance with the environmental and social management plan and to report to them each year, and that the majority of the construction impacts were addressed as the plan provided.
kribi-gas-plant-land-and-crops-taken-mpo.ct_note: The guarantee agreement with the local lenders and the project agreement between the Association and Kribi Power Development Company, both of January 2012, are listed as sources at the back of the Bank's completion report and a 2015 Bank briefing paper shows the project agreement carried covenants, but neither agreement is published anywhere, so what the financing obliged the power company itself to do cannot be read.

pdue-cameroon-unpaid-compensation-yaound.conditions_add: The financing agreement for Credit 4313-CM, dated 15 November 2007, required Cameroon, "before commencing the implementation of any activity" needing an environmental and social impact assessment, to prepare and furnish to the Association that assessment and any environmental management plan or resettlement action plan, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association, setting out the adverse impacts, the measures to offset, reduce or mitigate them and the arrangements for monitoring them; to disclose the documents publicly; and to "carry out or cause to be carried out any activity required under any EMP or RAP to mitigate, reduce, offset and/or compensate any adverse impact" (Schedule 2, Section I.D.2). The same section barred amending or waiving the frameworks without the Association's agreement and required enough qualified staff in the coordination unit to plan, prepare, implement, supervise and monitor those plans. The project agreement of the same date put the identical duty on the implementing entity, and the additional financing agreement of 29 December 2010 carried the requirements forward.

drc-rn5-rn6-rn2-compensation-arrears.conditions_add: The development grant agreement for Grant H164-ZR, dated 28 June 2005, required the Democratic Republic of the Congo to carry out the project in accordance with the environmental and social impact assessment, the Environmental and Social Impact Management Framework and the Resettlement Policy Framework and, as the case might be, the environmental and social management plan and the resettlement action plan, and barred amending or waiving any of them without the Association's agreement where that could materially harm the project (Schedule 4, Part II). None of those documents existed when the money was agreed: Section 3.03 required the assessment, the management framework and the resettlement framework to be prepared and publicly disclosed, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association, within twelve months of the agreement taking effect. The agreement defines the resettlement framework as the policy framework for land acquisition, compensation, resettlement and rehabilitation of displaced people, and the action plan as the plan, satisfactory to the Association, describing the measures to mitigate the project's impact on them.

drc-urban-project-injury-threats-and-wor.conditions_add: The project ran from 2013 under Grant H8420-ZR, whose financing agreement the Bank does not publish; the only agreement published that carries covenants is the financing agreement for the additional credit 6034-ZR, dated 13 June 2017, four years into implementation. That agreement required that where a project activity would affect anyone, "no displacement (including restriction of access to legally designated parks and protected areas) shall occur before resettlement measures under a Supplemental Social and Environmental Safeguards Instrument prepared in accordance with the RPF including, in the case of displacement, full payment to Affected Persons of compensation and of other assistance required for relocation, have been taken" (Schedule 2, Section I.G.1(b)), and required each such instrument to be prepared under the framework, furnished to the Association for review and approval and adopted before the activity began, with regular reports on compliance, on anything interfering with it and on remedies. The completion report of 17 February 2022 records three cases of non-compliance, two of them construction started before the resettlement plan was carried out, one of those even before the contract had been signed; in one the Bank "notified the client that the investment would not be eligible for project financing, and no project funds were used for the construction works", in the other corrective measures allowed the works to continue, and the third concerned a person who reported a site in Mbandaka and was then allegedly threatened by provincial authorities, after which a field mission "was able to confirm both safeguards compliance on the construction site as well as the safety of the complainant". The report does not date any of the three, so whether the 2017 covenant was in force when they happened cannot be settled from it.

kinshasa-water-works-land-and-houses-tak.conditions_add: The financing agreement for Grant H282-ZR, dated 11 April 2007, required the Democratic Republic of the Congo to adopt an environmental and social management framework and a resettlement policy framework satisfactory to the Association within six months of the agreement taking effect, and thereafter to implement the project in accordance with them, "including the preparation, disclosure and implementation of an ESIA, EMP or RAP, if necessary, satisfactory to the Association before the start of the works" under Parts C and D (Schedule 2, Section I.C.1). It also required the implementing unit to enter into and keep an agreement with a safeguard management firm for the life of the project. The completion report of 27 November 2013 says the two frameworks "were prepared late, 13 months after effectiveness" against the agreement's six-month deadline, that the Bank "ensured that no construction works took place prior to the completion and disclosure of the safeguards instruments", and that over the cash payments of US$1,215,322 owed to people affected by the water component, "The Bank procedures did not allow payment of cash compensation on Bank funds, but finally the Bank consented to waiving this provision to allow works to commence, as the government did not have funds to pay the compensations".

colombia-water-easements-unsettled-at-cl.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 2 June 2005 required Colombia, through the environment ministry, to "ensure that prior to initiating the implementation of any Territorial Entity Subproject under Part A.1 of the Project, said Territorial Entity Subprojects shall comply, in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank, with: (i) the provisions of the IPDF; (ii) the provisions of the PFCR; and (iii) the applicable environmental measures set forth in the EMF" (Section 3.08(b)). The PFCR is defined as the policy framework for compensation and resettlement of affected persons, dated 15 October 2004 and adopted on the ministry's website. The same section required the ministry to agree and coordinate with the participating municipalities all actions needed to minimise involuntary loss of shelter, productive assets or livelihood, and to send the Bank any proposed revision of the frameworks and make only the revisions the Bank had agreed.
